claim: Default builds keep the original 16 colours with smoother, similar gameplay; anything beyond (extended colours, painted scenery, effects) is an option the player switches on in the patch menu.

evidence.text: Owner priorities: default build in the original 16 colours, picture may be redrawn per pixel to remove attribute clash but only those colours; extra colour sets and toggles are byte differences in the .nxc (at most 4 toggles).
